lead_raw_text:
The structure of Eu2MgZn crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a cell formula of Eu8Mg4Zn4 and 16 atoms distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived CrystalNN analysis shows Eu centers with 12 geometric neighbors (3 Mg, 9 Zn) and 10 neighbors (8 Mg, 2 Zn), while Mg and Zn each have 11 neighbors; the periodic neighbor graph is three-dimensional and connected across all 16 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing contacts include corner- and face-sharing between 11-vertex Mg and 11-vertex Zn polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among Eu-centered 12-vertex polyhedra.
